core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nejat is a Turkish-origin name meaning “Salvation, safety, deliverance”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Turkish word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nejat corresponds to the Turkish form نَجَاة (Turkish Necat, from Arabic نَجَاة (najāh)). Its core sense is salvation, safety, deliverance. Nejat is the Turkish form of Arabic نَجَاة (najāh) 'salvation, safety, deliverance'. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave نِجَاط (a non-standard form) and labelled the origin Arabic; the name as spelled is Turkish. The source gloss 'Safety, Salvation, Security' is consistent.

persian.name: نجات
persian.long_meaning: Nejat (نجات) نامی برگرفته از زبان ترکی است و معنای اصلی آن نجات، رهایی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: नजात

arabic.name: نَجَاة
